                  [32m'    if rt <= 500:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        acc["satisfied"] += 1\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    elif rt <= 2000:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        acc["tolerating"] += 1\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return acc\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'def merge_accs(acc1, acc2):\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        "satisfied": acc1["satisfied"] + acc2["satisfied"],\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        "tolerating": acc1["tolerating"] + acc2["tolerating"],\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        "total": acc1["total"] + acc2["total"],\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'def format_result(item):\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    key, (acc, meta) = item\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    satisfied = acc["satisfied"]\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    tolerating = acc["tolerating"]\n'[39m +

                  [32m'    \n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if total > 0:\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        apdex_score = (satisfied + (tolerating / 2.0)) / total\n'[39m +

                  [32m'        "service": service,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        "apdex_score": round(apdex_score, 2)\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'# Aggregate with fold_window\n'[39m +

                  [32m'# Map downstream and metadata streams to string keys for joining\n'[39m +
